items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: I was in a band in Crowley, Louisiana, called Ike Jenkins Band.

ctx.x: I was in a band in Crowley, Louisiana, called Ike Jenkins Band. And Bunk Johnson, well he lived in New Iberia. Well he, sometime when Ike Jenkins needed a trumpet player, he'd send over to New Iberia and get Bunk Johnson and have Bunk Johnson come to Crowley, Crowley, Louisiana. But Bunk would come over to Crowley and play with our band. Well I was an Ike Jenkins drummer. And that's how I got a chance to play with Bunk Johnson.
